How it Works

4 steps.
One journey.

01
Post your delivery
Enter pickup & drop stations, add a photo, set your price. Under 60 seconds. Escrow locks instantly.
02
Traveler accepts
A KYC-verified commuter on your exact route accepts and shares their gate arrival in real time.
03
OTP pickup & ride
Parcel handed over via OTP at the gate. Track it station-by-station in real time.
04
Paid. Done. Repeat.
Receiver confirms via OTP. Escrow releases instantly. Ratings exchanged. Everyone wins.

FAQ

Got questions?

Everything you need to know before your first Mextros delivery.

How does Mextros ensure my parcel is safe?
▼
Every traveler undergoes KYC verification. Pickup and delivery both require OTP. Payment is held in escrow until confirmed delivery — triple protection at every stage.
How much can I earn as a traveler?
▼
Most regular commuters earn ₹800–₹2,000 per month with zero extra travel. Top leaderboard travelers earn significantly more through streak bonuses and tier rewards.
What types of parcels can be sent?
▼
Documents, small packages, clothing, food, electronics — anything that fits in a bag and is legal to carry on the metro. A parcel photo is mandatory when posting.
When does the traveler get paid?
▼
Payment releases instantly to wallet when receiver confirms via OTP. Bank/UPI withdrawals process within 24 hours with no fees.
Is Mextros on iOS and Android?
▼
Yes — available on both iOS App Store and Google Play. Also works as a PWA so you can install directly from your browser without the app store.

// ABOUT_US

We are Mextros

Our Story

Millions of people travel the same routes every single day, while packages sit idle waiting for expensive courier services. Why not connect them?

We built the first peer-to-peer delivery network designed specifically around metro transit. Today, Mextros operates across all Delhi NCR metro lines — covering 285 stations from Dwarka to Noida, Gurugram to Ghaziabad.

Our Mission

"Turn every commute into an opportunity — for senders and travelers alike."

We believe delivery shouldn't cost a fortune. We believe commuters deserve to earn from journeys they're already making. And we believe trust can be built at scale — with the right technology.

The Team

We're a lean team of engineers, designers, and logistics obsessives based in Delhi. We're hiring — reach out at careers@mextros.in

// PRIVACY_POLICY

Your Privacy Matters

Last updated: January 2025

What We Collect

We collect only what's needed to run the platform: your name, phone number, email, and government ID for KYC verification. For travelers, we also collect route data to match deliveries.

How We Use It

  • Matching senders with travelers on the same route
  • KYC verification and fraud prevention
  • Payment processing via escrow
  • Customer support and dispute resolution
  • Platform improvement and analytics (anonymized)

What We Never Do

  • We never sell your personal data to third parties
  • We never expose your phone number to other users
  • We never share your location history without consent

Data Security

All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Payment data is handled by PCI-DSS compliant processors. We conduct regular security audits.

Your Rights

You can request deletion of your data at any time by emailing privacy@mextros.in. We'll process your request within 7 working days.

// TERMS_OF_SERVICE

Terms of Service

Effective: January 2025 · Governing Law: India

Acceptance

By using Mextros, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the platform. We may update these terms and will notify you via email or in-app notification.

Eligibility

  • You must be 18 years or older
  • You must complete KYC verification to act as a traveler
  • You must have a valid Indian phone number

Sender Responsibilities

Senders are responsible for accurate package descriptions, legal contents, and ensuring items are properly packaged. Prohibited items include weapons, illegal substances, live animals, and hazardous materials.

Traveler Responsibilities

Travelers must deliver packages only on their stated route, maintain package safety, and complete OTP handoff at both pickup and delivery. Fraudulent activity results in permanent account ban and legal action.

Escrow & Payments

Payment is held in escrow until delivery is confirmed by both parties. Disputes are reviewed within 48 hours. Mextros charges a 12% platform fee on each transaction.

Limitation of Liability

Mextros acts as a platform connecting senders and travelers. Maximum liability per delivery is capped at ₹5,000 unless additional insurance is purchased in-app.

// REFUND_POLICY

Refund Policy

Automatic Refunds

You get a full refund automatically in these situations:

  • No traveler accepts your delivery within 2 hours
  • Traveler cancels after accepting
  • Delivery not completed within agreed timeframe
  • Package damaged or lost in transit

Refunds are processed within 24 hours to your original payment method.

Dispute-Based Refunds

If there's a disagreement between sender and traveler, raise a dispute in the app within 24 hours of the expected delivery time. Our team reviews all disputes within 48 hours.

Partial Refunds

If a traveler completes part of the route (e.g., pickup done but can't deliver), a partial refund may apply based on the distance covered.

Non-Refundable Cases

  • Sender provides incorrect pickup/delivery info
  • Prohibited items declared after delivery
  • Sender cancels after traveler has picked up the package

Contact for Refunds

Call +91 9990522424 or email support@mextros.in
